sources.reason: Canonical runtime CSS variables for AIOS color, shadow, chart, platform, and domain taxonomy tokens.
sources.notAllowed: Page-local materials, one-off chart colors, or component-specific raw colors.

sources.reason: Generated/static TypeScript mirror of DESIGN_TOKENS.json for token consumers.
sources.allowed: Canonical token values mirrored from DESIGN_TOKENS.json.
sources.notAllowed: Component-local colors or manually invented values outside DESIGN.md.

sources.reason: Shared platform legend and marker colors for charts and category dots.
sources.allowed: Documented platform colors for Tmall, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, JD, WeChat, and fallback platform markers.
sources.notAllowed: Generic UI colors, button colors, status colors, or page decoration.

sources.reason: Business taxonomy palettes for traffic hierarchy, TOPSIS quadrants, funnel stages, creator levels, cooperation stages, and ordinary chart series.
sources.allowed: Documented domain taxonomy palettes and chart series aliases.
sources.notAllowed: Generic status, trend, platform, or page-local material colors.

sources.reason: ECharts runtime defaults and helper colors that bridge design tokens to chart options.
sources.allowed: Chart theme constants, token-backed fallbacks, gradients, and chart helper materials.
sources.notAllowed: Page-specific chart category colors that belong in domain or platform sources.

sources.reason: CSS variable adapter for ECharts defaults and platform/chart token fallbacks.
sources.allowed: ECharts CSS custom-property defaults and token fallback values.
sources.notAllowed: Page-local CSS colors or one-off component styling.

sources.reason: Ant Design theme adapter that maps design tokens into Ant token slots.
sources.allowed: Token-derived Ant Design mappings and explicitly isolated dark-theme adapter values.
sources.notAllowed: Page-specific Ant component styling or local color experiments.

sources.reason: Creator dashboard has dense ECharts materials and tooltip treatments that are not yet reusable global tokens.
sources.allowed: Creator chart text, structural, material, tooltip, level, and platform semantics grouped by role.
sources.notAllowed: Generic AIOS UI colors, ordinary page styling, or colors that should already live in shared token/domain/platform sources.

sources.reason: Dashboard runtime token aliases must be imported as plain CSS so Vite production extraction keeps critical dashboard variables.
sources.allowed: Dashboard-local material primitives, translucent surfaces, shadows, and runtime aliases required by production dashboard routes.
sources.notAllowed: Generic AIOS UI colors, new chart palettes, or values that should live in global design tokens, platform colors, or domain taxonomy colors.

sources.reason: Homepage material aliases must be imported as plain CSS so Vite production extraction keeps page-local glass, spotlight, and shadow variables.
sources.allowed: Homepage-local material primitives used by page.module.css and page-hero.module.css.
sources.notAllowed: Generic AIOS UI colors, chart palettes, or values that should live in global design tokens, platform colors, or domain taxonomy colors.
